title: Binary tree basics & DFS traversals
learn: terminology (root, leaf, height, depth), pre/in/post-order (recursive + iterative with stack), 'ask children, combine' recursion
hook: Trees are the most asked topic after arrays, and almost every tree question is solved by the same recursive shape: handle the empty tree, ask both children, combine. Maximum Depth, Invert Tree and Same Tree are that shape in three lines.

explain.prompt: Explain how you'd compute the maximum depth of a binary tree recursively, and how preorder, inorder and postorder traversals differ.
keyPoints: recursive shape: empty tree is the base case, recurse on left and right, combine at the node
preorder visits node before children, inorder between them, postorder after them
O(n) time, O(h) space for the recursion (h = height, up to n when skewed)
